body.x: GYEONGGI, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2007') -- <Visual News> HUMANTEC presented its car-use handset stand ‘BESCAP’ in Korea market during KES 2007, which is connected with cigar jack. The high-end handset stand is expected to be available in end October, and suggested price is between 150,000(KRW) and 160,000(KRW).
